name: hawkeye
description: Set up HawkEye monitoring from your codebase: heartbeats for your cron jobs and scheduled tasks, and monitors for your site, its health endpoint, API and email records.

api_key.title: HawkEye API key
api_key.description: A HawkEye API key with Read and write access (it starts with hk_). Create one at https://hawkeye.observer/api-keys; read and write keys can add monitors on every plan, including Free.
